candidates.name: Left Elbow Adduction Drill
candidates.purpose: Improve left elbow position and location in downswing (position #1 vs #2)
setup: Set up more bent over from waist and knees
execution: Lower clubhead to ground by lowering hands
Keep left elbow straight
Cock wrists immediately from P1.1 to P2.0
Maximum backswing P3.0
Adduct left elbow back toward ball with wrists cocked
Transfer weight 4-6 inches to N-0 ball position
candidates.feel: Dramatic difference in left elbow position (#1 instead of #2); compression on the ball; elbow adducting toward body median line

candidates.name: Three Momentum Transfer Timing Drill
execution: At P3.0 begin moving left elbow up address baseline
Note clubhead still moving toward target
Time hip COG movement with elbow movement
Coordinate all three transfers to peak at impact
candidates.feel: Clubhead mass, body weight (hip COG), and arms mass coordinated
three_transfers: Clubhead mass toward target (P3.0 to P4.0)
Body weight (Hip COG) up address baseline

candidates.name: Spine Alignment Setup Drill
candidates.purpose: Establish correct upper body tilt at address (~5° left)
execution: At address align outside of right knee to right shoulder in straight line
Feel upper torso tilted slightly LEFT (~5°)
Check Lines #1 #2 #3 (lumbar, thoracic, cervical)
Maintain 5° tilt through P6.0 and into follow-through
candidates.feel: Not punch-shot setup; reverse C at finish when correct

candidates.name: Right Arm/Clubshaft Angle Maintenance Drill
candidates.purpose: Maintain 110° angle from P2.0 to P4.0
execution: Take club to P2.0 (club parallel, toe up)
Check 110° between right arm and clubshaft
Continue to P4.0 maintaining exact same angle
If clubshaft wobbles at top, angle has changed
candidates.feel: No change in right arm/clubshaft angle; no change in left elbow flexion

candidates.name: Humeral-Scapula Activation Drill
candidates.purpose: Learn to move arm independently of body pivot (arm speed)
setup: Can be done without club first
execution: Extend left arm in front with no elbow flexion
Move arm laterally left then right (shoulder joint)
At address practice moving entire left arm up baseline
Body pivots but arm moves independently forward
Do NOT deactivate shoulder joint in downswing
candidates.feel: Entire arm (not just elbow) moves as fast as possible back in front of body

candidates.name: Knock-Down Shot Practice (Seve Style)
candidates.purpose: Master elbow adduction and compression via abbreviated knock-down
execution: Abbreviated backswing (P3.0 max)
Adduct left elbow toward ball
Keep wrists cocked
Transfer weight through impact
Feel compression; short follow-through
candidates.feel: Elbow position #1, adduction location, ball compression, trajectory control

candidates.name: Progressive Distance Putting (1–300 ft)
candidates.purpose: Expand cerebellum distance database; build speed→line control across all lengths
setup: Putting green with room for long lags; do not groove one hole
execution: Hit on the order of 100 putts per distance over time
Every foot-distance from 1 ft through 300 ft
Do not skip distances
For each putt: Read, Look, See, Feel, Stroke
candidates.feel: Clubhead speed into ball speed that controls line
candidates.notes: This is a multi-month/year PROGRAM more than a 10-minute drill. Product may expose as 'program' not single session drill.

candidates.name: Heels-Together Pendulum (Dean Martin) + volume ladder
candidates.purpose: Feel true pendulum rhythm; volume practice 1–50+ ft
setup: Weak right hand grip, strong left hand grip
Clubshaft aligned through palms of both hands
execution: Clubhead swings off ground upward immediately in backswing
Immediately upward in follow-through (pendulum)
Left elbow flexion backswing; extension forward; right elbow flexion follow-through
Do not use wrists
Volume protocol: 100 putts at 1 ft, then 2 ft, ... through 10 ft and continue ladder (email describes up toward 50 ft / 1000 putts total context)
Walk around holes to avoid grooving green
candidates.feel: Clubhead as true pendulum; rhythm of up-down-up
